frames.title: Shopify Facebook & Instagram Sales Channel Overview
frames.on_screen: Shopify admin page: 'Facebook & Instagram'. Main card: 'Connect your shop to Facebook and Instagram' with a 'Get started' button. Key features highlighted: 'IMPROVED PRODUCT RECOMMENDATIONS', 'PERSONALIZED CONSIDERATION JOURNEY', 'SMART TRAFFIC ROUTING'.
frames.not_in_transcript: URL: admin.shopify.com/store/laifen/apps/facebook-ads/shopify_app/home. Left navigation shows store navigation items (Home, Orders, Products, Customers, Content, Finance, Analytics, Marketing, Discounts, Sales channels).

frames.title: Facebook & Instagram Data Sharing and Dataset Selection
frames.on_screen: Shopify admin setup step: 'Data sharing'. Preference shown: 'Maximum' ('Customer activity data is shared using the Meta Pixel, advanced matching and Conversions API'). Section: 'Connect a dataset to track customer behavior' listing datasets (EAM-YOUTUBE ID: 1602392147111647, test, Hypeach Offline Events - EAM, Wazoo Gear Offline Events) with 'Connect' buttons.
frames.not_in_transcript: Subsections below: 'Advertising', 'Business details'. Link to 'Off-Facebook Activity'.

frames.title: Manage Facebook & Instagram Data Sharing Preference Modal
frames.on_screen: Modal: 'Manage Facebook & Instagram data sharing preference'. Toggle 'Share data' is enabled. 'Choose Preference' options: 'CONSERVATIVE', 'ENHANCED', 'MAXIMUM' (selected). Note explains: 'Customer activity data is shared using the Meta Pixel, advanced matching, and Conversions API. Customers can disconnect this data from their Facebook account by changing their settings for Off-Facebook Activity.'
frames.not_in_transcript: Privacy warning note: 'This option shares your customers' personal data. To help them understand how it's used to power relevant advertising on Facebook, read these useful Facebook resources. Make sure your privacy policy reflects how you use personal data...'

frames.title: Shopify Facebook & Instagram Setup Checklist and Terms
frames.on_screen: Screen: 'Set up your shop - Complete setup to start selling your products on Facebook and Instagram'. Checklist items (all checked green): 'Prepare your accounts for setup', 'Facebook account', 'Business assets', 'Data sharing', 'Advertising', 'Business details'. Open section: 'Terms and conditions' with checkbox 'I agree to the Seller Agreement' and checked checkbox 'Give people in my Meta business portfolio full access to this catalog'. 'Submit for review' button.
frames.not_in_transcript: Checkbox labels and links: 'Seller Agreement', 'About catalog access'.

frames.title: Meta Business Suite Datasets & Pixels Settings
frames.on_screen: Meta Business Suite Settings > Data Sources > Datasets & pixels. Dataset selected: 'EasyAMedia 2022 Pixel' (Meta Pixel - Conversions API, Owned by: Media A Easy). Status: 'Dataset is receiving events'. Tab 'Connected assets' selected showing '1 asset is connected to this Dataset' with Ad account 'EAM 1' and 'Disconnect' button. Button 'Connect assets' at top right.
